comparison.objective: Use a prepared two-jaw screw puller to extract a fitted collar, recover it in a tray, and park the intact tool.
comparison.physical_skill: Counterhold a loose puller while repeatedly turning and regrasping its screw, then bimanually transfer, spread jaws, release the collar, and place the tool.
comparison.success_condition: Collar clears the shaft after measured screw rotation, remains in the tray, and the intact puller rests within tight pose tolerances for two seconds with hands clear.
comparison.reason: Although both tasks include bimanual stabilization and rotary tool manipulation, this record tests forceful extraction, recovered-part handling, jaw spreading, and tool parking. The candidate tests fine damping adjustment, setscrew locking, and retained dynamic stopping performance; the shared primitives do not amount to the same ability. Candidate rebound, overload, and post-lock drift thresholds remain numerically incomplete.
